source: A broker's compliance calendar for November 2026 (Trading, DP and RA & IA sheets; PMS left out), each item checked against the circulars in force on 17 November 2026.
note: Each duty: the circulars that set it, the steps a circular lists (else the usual practice), how it is done and whether by API, and what in Ledgerline does or checks it.

duties.title: Report client-wise margin collected (EOD and peak) to each clearing corporation by T+5
duties.due_text: TMs/CMs report the margin collected from each client (EOD and peak) for each trade day; files must be in by the end of T+5 trading days (the 'sign-off date'). Master circular para 40.1.8: 'report to the Stock Exchange on T+5 day the actual short-collection/non-collection of all margins'.
duties.filed_with: NSE Clearing (CIM, or extranet /FAOFTP/F<member>/COLAT/UPLD; cash segment under CMFTP); ICCL; MCXCCL; each other clearing corporation for its segments
duties.evidence: Uploaded F_MRG_TM/F_MRG_CM files per segment and trade date, the clearing corporation's return files (F_MRG_TMF_, F_MRG_TMR_), penalty files (PNL01), and the client collateral/ledger snapshots behind each figure

refs.says: Peak-margin framework: CCs send client-wise EOD and peak requirement (MG-12/13); members report EOD and peak margin collected; penalty on the higher shortfall.

refs.title: Master Circular for Stock Brokers
refs.says: Para 40.1.8: report short/non-collection to the exchange on T+5 day; para 41.3-41.5: MG-12/13 files carry EOD and peak requirement, member reports EOD and peak collected, penalty on the higher shortfall (mirror: MSE copy, MSE/INSP/17380/2025).

api.detail: No upload API found: NSE Clearing's NMASS margins API (built in Ledgerline) only downloads margin data. Ledgerline already writes the NSE Clearing CM and F&O files and the MCXCCL file; the ICCL layout is still missing.

steps: Download the day's client margin file (MG13 for a TM, MG12 for a CM) from the extranet; it gives each client's EOD and peak margin requirement (master circular para 41.3).
Fill in the margin collected for each client row (EOD and peak, para 41.4) without changing any other field; a modified record is rejected.
Name the file F_MRG_TM_<DDMMYYYY>_nn.CSV (CM: F_MRG_CM_...), with the trade date and a batch number 01-99; the latest batch for a trade day is final.
Upload to /FAOFTP/F<member>/COLAT/UPLD on the extranet or through the Collateral Interface for Members (CIM) by the end of T+5, the sign-off date.
Read the return files (F_MRG_TMF_ for a rejected file, F_MRG_TMR_ for record results, codes 07 insufficient / 08 sufficient) in CIM or COLAT/DNLD; correct and re-upload before sign-off.
Review the penalty file F_PNL01_<member>_DDMMYYYY.CSV for short or non-reported margin.
duties.steps_from: NSE 'Client Margin Reporting - Equity Derivatives' page (F&O segment; cash and currency use their own segment folders); EOD/peak content from master circular para 41.3-41.4
practice: Repeat per segment (CM, F&O, CD, commodity) and per clearing corporation (NSE Clearing, ICCL, MCXCCL); collateral with each CC is reported to that CC.
Pass a short-collection penalty to a client only where NSE/INSP/64315 allows it (dishonoured cheque, disclosed hedge break).
duties.changed: The calendar's 'Within T+5 days' still holds: it means T+5 trading days (sign-off date), per CC schedules. Since the peak-margin framework (SEBI 2020/127), the report has both EOD and peak margin collected. Filing is with each clearing corporation, not with the exchanges; margin reporting is not one of NSE's common submissions (NSE/INSP/69184, 70505).

ledgerline.what: Ledgerline works out each client's margin collected and any short collection (peak and end of day) and the penalty; the clearing corporation's margin file is uploaded on its portal.

duties.title: Check the investor grievance mailbox each trading day and log every complaint in the register
duties.due_text: No circular sets a daily check. The rule is an exclusive email ID used only for investor complaints, shown on the website and investor material; complaints are resolved within 21 calendar days (SCORES 2.0 / investor charter).
duties.filed_with: Kept by the firm (exclusive grievance email ID and complaints register)
duties.evidence: Grievance mailbox log; complaints register with date received, source, category, due date, status and resolution date; acknowledgements sent

refs.title: Exclusive e-mail ID for redressal of investor complaints
refs.says: Brokers, exchanges, depositories and DPs designate an email ID of the grievance cell/compliance officer used exclusively for investor complaints and display it prominently on the website and investor material.

refs.title: Master Circular for Stock Brokers (Section VII, Investor Grievance Redressal)
refs.says: Para 75 keeps the exclusive email ID for investor complaints; para 76 SCORES; para 78 investor charter and website disclosure of complaints (MSE copy, MSE/INSP/17380/2025).

refs.title: Redressal of investor grievances through SCORES and linking it to ODR
refs.says: Entities resolve complaints and file the ATR within 21 calendar days of receipt (Annexure I 1.2-1.3), in force from 4 Dec 2023.

api.detail: Kept by the firm; there is nothing to submit.

practice: Keep one exclusive grievance email ID on the website, account opening kit and contract notes; check it each trading day.
Log each complaint the same day with date received, source (direct, SCORES, exchange, other), category and a due date 21 calendar days out; acknowledge the investor.
Bring SCORES and exchange-forwarded complaints into the same register so the monthly disclosure (T23) is built from one source.
duties.changed: Daily verification is good practice, not a circular requirement. The governing rules are the exclusive email ID (SEBI 2006; Stock Brokers Master Circular 2025 para 75) and the 21-calendar-day resolution clock.

ledgerline.what: Record each complaint from the grievance mailbox in Investor complaints; Ledgerline tracks the 21 days and the monthly disclosure.

duties.title: Keep a daily reconciliation of transfers between client, settlement and own bank accounts
duties.due_text: Daily: the stock broker 'shall maintain a daily reconciliation statement' of amounts transferred between client account, settlement account and own (proprietary) account (master circular para 15.4.4.2; originally SEBI 2016/95 para 2.4.2).
duties.filed_with: Kept by the firm (checked in exchange inspections and the half-yearly internal audit)
duties.evidence: Signed daily reconciliation statement; bank statements of USCNBA, DSCNBA, settlement and own accounts; vouchers for each client-to-own transfer (brokerage, charges, statutory dues)

refs.title: Master Circular for Stock Brokers
refs.says: Para 15.3.2: accounts named USCNB (receipts), DSCNB (payments) and Settlement Account; para 15.4.4.2: transfers client to settlement account and back allowed, client to own only for legitimate purposes, with a daily reconciliation statement; 15.4.4.3: checked in inspection and internal audit (mirror: MSE copy).

refs.title: Enhanced Supervision of Stock Brokers / Depository Participants
refs.says: Original rule (paras 1.2 and 2.4.2): naming of Client, Settlement and Proprietary accounts; client-to-own transfers only for brokerage, statutory dues etc., with a daily reconciliation statement (mirror: taxheal copy).

refs.title: Upstreaming of clients' funds by Stock Brokers (SBs) / Clearing Members (CMs) to Clearing Corporations (CCs)
refs.says: Para 3.C.II: client funds received only in USCNBA and paid only from DSCNBA after funds come back from the CC the same day.

refs.title: FAQ on Upstreaming of clients' funds by Stock Brokers (SBs) / Clearing Members (CMs) to Clearing Corporations (CCs)
refs.says: DSCNB funds received after the cut-off may be paid out the same day; no balance there at EOD except on RAS days with bank instructions given by EOD.

api.detail: Not submitted: an internal record checked during inspection and internal audit.

practice: At EOD, match the bank statements of USCNBA, DSCNBA, settlement and own accounts with the ledger, and list every transfer between them with date, amount, purpose and voucher.
Allow client-to-own transfers only for brokerage, charges and statutory dues already debited to clients' ledgers; flag anything else as a breach.
Have it prepared by operations and signed off by a checker; keep it for inspection and the internal auditor.
duties.changed: Since upstreaming (SEBI 2023/84, from July 2023) the single 'Client Account' is split into USCNBA (receipts) and DSCNBA (payments) with client money upstreamed to the CC at EOD, so the reconciliation now covers USCNBA, the CC, DSCNBA, the settlement account and own accounts. Nothing is filed with NSE/BSE/MSE/MCX/NCDEX, despite the calendar's 'where' column. SEBI HO/38/11/(1)2026-MIRSD-POD/I/7656/2026 (23 Mar 2026, NSE/INSP/73436) removed demat account reporting only; bank account naming and reporting stay.

ledgerline.what: Ledgerline prepares each business day's statement of transfers between the USCNBA, DSCNBA, settlement and own accounts and the clearing corporation, flags receipts or payments outside the nodal accounts, money taken to own beyond the charges debited to clients and a DSCNBA balance at end of day, and a checker signs it off.

steps: Prepare the day's client-level collateral segregation report in NSE Clearing's format, for every day including Saturday (NSE/INSP/61121).
Report unidentified or suspense funds under the back-office UCC SUSPE1234N on the member's PAN; don't create it in the exchange UCC database (NCL/CMPL/64088).
Put early pay-in of funds in column 46 (cash placed with CC), and don't reduce the peak clear balance (column 12) for settlement bills due that day (NCL/CMPL/64088).
Log in to the NCL Member Portal (ims.connect2nsccl.com/NCLMemberPortal) with a sub-user holding the NCL INSPECTION role and upload the report (NCL/CMPL/69872).
Upload by 23:59:59 on T+1; the data can't be changed after the cut-off (NCL/CMPL/56655).
Report collateral held with other clearing corporations to those CCs; report funds received after cut-off as retained with a justification code (NCL/CMPL/76318, NCL/CMPL/61186).

Report money kept back from the clearing corporation on a line per reason code RC01-RC09 (column 52), the amount in column 22, client fields blank; money paid after the cut-off first meets the client's debit and only the rest is RC01 (NCL/CMPL/61186 Annexure 1; NCL/CMPL/76318 FAQ 5). api.name: NSE holding statement API
api.detail: Live in Ledgerline (nseholdingapi.go). BSE submission not needed for NSE members from 15 Oct 2025 (common submission).

steps: Register for the API on NSE's inspection member portal; NSE emails the login ID, password and secret key.
Call /inspectionapi/login with the password AES-encrypted to get a bearer token, valid for 30 minutes.
Gzip the day's holding JSON as PAN_HS_DDMMYYYY_Seqno.gz (date matching the date and filePeriodDate fields) and POST it to /inspectionapi/tradingHoldingUpload/1.0.
Send days in order: a day is refused (805) until the previous day is in; Friday and Saturday data go on Monday; after an error resend the whole day.
Check the response (601 success, 603 partial, 604 all wrong; 9xx record, 5xx file errors) and keep the acknowledgement.
If no client securities are held, file the one-time Nil Holding declaration on T+1; before resuming, file Bulk Nil Holding (Statement upload > Holding Statement Daily > Bulk Nil Holding Reporting).

refs.title: Surveillance Indicator for securities under Additional Surveillance Measure (ASM)
refs.says: Origin of the rule: SurvInd = 9 in security files marks ASM; warning 'Security is under Surveillance Measure, would you like to continue?' at order entry.

api.detail: Nothing is filed. The cautionary files are published daily on the NSE website for the front ends to load; the pop-up lives in the trading software, not the back office.

steps: Download the exchange's daily cautionary file (REG_INDDDMMYY.csv, replaced by REG1_INDDDMMYY.csv from 6 Dec 2024 EOD) and fo_secban; they apply from the next trading day.
On order entry in a flagged scrip, show one pop-up 'Security is under - <every applicable indicator>, would you like to continue?' with Yes/No, using the circular's wording verbatim.
Send the order to the exchange only if the user selects 'Yes'.
Keep a log of every pop-up shown, per scrip, with the option the client chose.
Management gives the logs to the Board, confirming all alerts were displayed and the choices recorded.
The system auditor checks in the periodic system audit that the functionality is deployed.

Spot-check a few flagged scrips in each front end (web, app, dealer terminal) and keep a screenshot.

duties.title: Clear PAN-Aadhaar seeding mismatches on the exchange UCC with an unfreeze request
duties.due_text: No fixed deadline. A UCC whose PAN is not shown as seeded with Aadhaar is 'Not Permitted to Trade' and cannot square off; NPTT reports run at 14:30 on working days and 22:00 daily, and UCCs made compliant by 22:00 can trade the next trading day. The facility works only when the PAN status is valid.
duties.filed_with: NSE UCI Online (Member Portal > UCI online > Other Options > Unfreezing requests); BSE and MCX UCC systems
duties.evidence: Request reference or UNF bulk file and its response log (TMCODE_UNF_YYYYMMDDHHMMSS.log); client's proof that PAN is linked with Aadhaar; next NPTT report showing the UCC permitted

steps: Find the affected UCCs in the NPTT report (SEG_TMCODE_RECORDS_NOT_PERMITTED_TO_TRADE_DDMMYYYY_nn on Extranet) or with Query Client.
Confirm with the client that the PAN is now linked with Aadhaar; the request is accepted only when the PAN status is valid.
Single UCC: Member Portal > UCI online > Other Options > Unfreezing requests > New request.
Bulk: upload UNF_YYYYMMDD.Tnn (pipe-delimited, control record 10, reason for unfreezing 8 = get updated Aadhaar-PAN seeding status) at Unfreezing requests > Bulk Upload-Unfreezing.
If documents are asked for, upload them at Unfreezing requests > Document Submission.
Read the response file TMCODE_UNF_YYYYMMDDHHMMSS.log for accepted and rejected records; recheck the UCC status next day.

steps: Receive all client funds only in the Up Streaming Client Nodal Bank Account (USCNBA).
Stop accepting fresh client funds 30 minutes before the broker's upstreaming cut-off (SEBI 2023/84 para 3.C.V).
Upstream clients' clear credit balances to the CC by the cut-off (NSE Clearing: 7:00 pm on settlement days) as cash, FDR lien-marked to the CC, or pledged overnight-MF units.
Allocate collateral client-wise and segment-wise in NMASS (Collateral Management > File allocation) or by the allocation API; end-of-day changes use the EOD option (NCL/CMPT/51657).
Send downward allocations before upward ones; each record is the client-segment's final amount, not an increment (NCL/CMPT/51657).
Pay clients only from the DSCNBA after funds come back from the CC the same day; leave nothing there at EOD, except RAS days with bank instructions given by EOD (NSE/INSP/58146).
File collateral release reasons by 11:59:59 pm the same day: Member portal > Inspection > Statement Upload > Collateral Segregation Submission > Reason for Collateral Release (NCL/CMPT/57227).
